mapper.select: SELECT c.CommentID, u.Username, c.Content, c.CommentTime FROM comment1707 c JOIN user1707 u ON c.UserID = u.UserID JOIN movie1707 m ON c.MovieID = m.MovieID WHERE m.Title = #{title} ORDER BY c.CommentTime DESC
SELECT m.*, c.CommentID, c.UserID, c.Content, c.CommentTime FROM comment1707 c JOIN movie1707 m ON c.MovieID = m.MovieID WHERE c.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY c.CommentTime DESC
SELECT c.*, u.Username FROM comment1707 c LEFT JOIN user1707 u ON c.UserID = u.UserID WHERE c.MovieID = #{movieId} ORDER BY c.CommentTime DESC
